title: Weathered
description: Makes Minecraft's environment as realistic as possible while keeping the vanilla feel.
body:
A pack made to simulate what challenges Steve would face surviving on earth. This pack features mods like Protomanly's Weather, Tough as Nails, Farmer's Delight, Create, and most importantly Untitled Duck Mod in order to achieve this. This pack features the standard vanilla progression, with other dimensions as close as possible to what they could feasably be in real life. For those who enjoy torturing their pcs, this pack includes distant horisons and shader compatability with pmweather.

Note: This pack is performance heavy and needs a relatively strong computer to run. Remove distant horisons if Minecraft runs slow.
